title: Microsoft Teams: AI phishing detection in chat messages
notes: claim 56: severity major on a rationale: risk rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout dates, automatic enablement and documented control paths and commands are supported. The risk rationale should not claim that detection only warns users, because Microsoft describes warnings without ruling out other behaviour. The read-only PowerShell command also needs its reference added to the sources.
